content: 1. Mirtazapine levels or effects may be altered due to interactions with hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 2. Mitotane decreases tipranavir levels by inducing hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Mitotane is a strong inducer of cytochrome P450 3A4; dosage adjustments may be necessary when coadministered with CYP3A4 substrates. 3. Tipranavir increases morphine levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 4. Nafcillin decreases tipranavir levels or effects by inducing hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 5. Tipranavir increases naldeMedine levels by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor for potential adverse effects when coadministered with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. 6. Tipranavir significantly increases naloxegol levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated due to the risk of opioid withdrawal symptoms caused by increased systemic exposure to naloxegol. 7. Tipranavir decreases nateglinide effects, potentially due to insulin resistance associated with protease inhibitors. Monitor closely for hyperglycemia. 8. Tipranavir increases nebivolol levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 9. Nefazodone increases tipranavir levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is serious; consider using an alternative drug. 10. Tipranavir increases nefazodone levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 11. Tipranavir increases nelfinavir levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Both drugs increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Use caution and monitor closely. 12. Tipranavir increases neratinib levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. 13. Tipranavir increases netupitant/palonosetron levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 14. Nevirapine decreases tipranavir levels or effects by inducing hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Both drugs increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Use caution and monitor closely. 15. Tipranavir may alter nicardipine levels due to contradictory effects on hepatic CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein. Use caution and monitor closely. 16. Tipranavir increases nifedipine levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 17. Tipranavir increases nilotinib levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 18. Tipranavir increases nimodipine levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely for potential toxicity. 19. Tipranavir decreases nintedanib levels by inducing P-glycoprotein efflux transporter. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 20. Tipranavir increases nirmatrelvir/ritonavir levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor for increased adverse events with concomitant use. 21. Tipranavir increases nisoldipine levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely for potential toxicity. 22. Tipranavir increases norethindrone levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 23. Tipranavir increases nortriptyline levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 24. Tipranavir increases olaparib levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, reduce the olaparib dose and monitor closely. 25. Tipranavir increases oliceridine levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely for respiratory depression and sedation. 26. Tipranavir increases ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 27. Tipranavir increases osilodrostat levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Reduce the osilodrostat dose by half when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 28. Tipranavir increases osimertinib levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 29. Tipranavir increases ospemifene levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 30. Oxcarbazepine decreases tipranavir levels or effects by inducing hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 31. Tipranavir increases oxycodone levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If coadministered, reduce the oxycodone dose and monitor closely. 32. Tipranavir increases paclitaxel levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 33. Tipranavir increases pacritinib levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 34. Tipranavir increases palbociclib levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, reduce the palbociclib dose and monitor closely. 35. Tipranavir increases panobinostat levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Reduce the panobinostat starting dose if coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 36. Tipranavir increases paricalcitol levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely for potential toxicity. 37. Tipranavir increases paroxetine levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 38. Tipranavir increases pazopanib levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 39. Tipranavir increases pemigatinib levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If coadministration is unavoidable, reduce the pemigatinib dose and monitor closely. 40. Tipranavir increases phenindione effects due to pharmacodynamic synergy. Use caution and monitor closely for bleeding risk. 41. Phenobarbital decreases tipranavir levels or effects by inducing hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 42. Phenytoin decreases tipranavir levels or effects by inducing hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 43. Tipranavir increases pimavanserin levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. If coadministered, reduce the pimavanserin dose and monitor closely. 44. Tipranavir increases pimozide levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 45. Tipranavir increases pitolisant levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Reduce the pitolisant dose by half when coadministered with strong CYP2D6 inhibitors. 46. Tipranavir increases polatuzumab vedotin levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely for increased toxicities. 47. Tipranavir increases pomalidomide levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism and decreases levels by inducing P-glycoprotein efflux transporter. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 48. Tipranavir increases ponatinib levels or effects by inhibiting hepatic or intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug.
